notes: The Arduino UNO WiFi Rev2 is not in the catalogue, so it is a new part type. Its pin layout is assumed to match the Uno R3 headers.
In the diagram the breadboard's top half is labelled rows j–f. The catalogue names rows a–e as bank 't' and rows f–j as bank 'b', so the top half is bank 'b'. For example, column 3 row g is '3b.g'.

The green wire runs from digital pin 2 to column 3 row g. The 220 ohm resistor spans column 3 row h to column 6 row h. The LED's longer, bent leg (anode) is in column 6 row i, sharing a strip with the resistor. Its straight leg (cathode) is in column 8 row i.
The black wire runs from the GND pin next to AREF (taken as GND.1) to column 8 row h. That is the LED cathode strip.
The USB cable and computer are used for upload and power but are not drawn in the circuit image, so they are left out.
The sketch reads analog pin A1 for a 'random reading'. Nothing is wired to A1, so it floats.
